notes.title: Update 5
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it’s now officially 7 days since Tiny Bookshop released, and finally, after tackling the most serious bugs, we found some time to take care of more UX and feedback.


[list]
[*] Adjusted/Fixed Maryam’s recommendation quest at the café not saving the progress consistently.
[*] Increased rain chance in spring slightly.
[*] Inspiring Klaus now counts anywhere, and not just at the supermarket.
[*] Adjusted Historic Tag. Changed it from “Written about the past” to “meeting a need of immersing yourself in the past”.
[*] Nerfed [spoiler]Professor Quest to make it less frustrating.[/spoiler]
[*] Made [spoiler]cases[/spoiler] visible and visually distinct to help you identify which one is currently active.
[*] Removed a dialogue gamepad deselection, that would lead to having to re-select dialogue. 
[*] Made Play and Long mutually exclusive, as plays don’t tend to be over 450 pages.
[*] Added a bail-out book box, in case you are out of money and out of books.
[*] Adjusted the [spoiler]gardening fundraiser[/spoiler] so it doesn’t keep subtracting money after the quest is completed.
[*] Fixed snow at Park.
[*] Fixed [spoiler]Nightmare Fuel-Effect[/spoiler] never disappearing.
[*] Adjusted spacing of location genres in the journal to avoid overlaps.
[*] Improved the UX of colouring your bookshop.
[*] Made [spoiler]Spoiled Fish[/spoiler] only placeable in one slot at a time, to avoid accidental smells.
[*] Fixed wildlife-board being obstructed at the fish-market.
[*] Made the [spoiler]Antique Lantern[/spoiler] slightly stronger.
[*] Fixed a glitching shadow at the Café.
[*] Made rain a little more likely in spring.
[/list]

[h2]Known Issue:[/h2]
Steam Cloud is still disabled, until we can figure out a way to test it safely. We are in contact with Steam Support! 🙏🙏🙏

[h2]Weekend:[/h2]
We’ll be taking this weekend off, after having worked through the last one. So I hope you’ll understand that we’ll try not to respond during this weekend.

Next week is also the Gamescom, where we will have a booth in the Indie Arena! We’ll still try to find time to respond to your questions, and fix urgent bugs if there are any, but communications might be a bit slower next week, as our 5-person-team has to staff the booth, too.


[h2]The First Week:[/h2]
This last week has been a blur for us. We never imagined that this many people would pick up our game! We are simply blown-away and exceptionally thankful for your support and passion for the game, and the kindness and positivity you bring to every conversation we had with you. We are lucky to have made a game for such a wonderful community! ♥️

As always, here is the link to the previous patch notes: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2133760/discussions/0/601912361526467372/

notes.title: Update 4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a robust local backup system for saves (One on start-up and one whenever you save)
[*] Fixed an issue where the game did not start due to a Steam back-end change
[*] Fixed typos and adjusted some book tags
[*] Fixed an issue where [spoiler]in the final quest you would sometimes not get an important item[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed the timing and conditions of some late game quests
[/list]

[h2]Known issue:[/h2]
There is currently an issue with Steam Cloud messing with the save files on Mac, and perhaps other OSes. That’s the reason we experienced and fixed the start-up bug, added [b]two[/b] additional back-up systems for your save files, and did not get much else done today. If you are affected, please try the solution posted in this thread: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2133760/discussions/0/601912361526441201/

If that doesn’t work, please mail us at developers at neoludic.games and we will try our best to help you.

We have alerted Steam Support of the issue, and are hoping we can resolve this together swiftly. We have also temporarily disabled Steam Cloud on the store page, until we are able to safely test and verify its integration.

Thank you everyone for your understanding, help and support! And for being so kind in your messages, despite this issue.

notes.title: Update 3
notes.content:
Hi everyone, thank you so so much for enjoying our game, and helping us find and fix some more rogue bugs! We're still waiting to verify our Steam Cloud fix with Valve, but here are all the things we fixed in the last 24 hours ✨

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that would sometimes arise when having back-to-back recommendations. Leading to a softlock.
[*] Fixed an issue where [spoiler]the plant-growing cutscenes would sometimes not reset properly[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed a bug where Tilde’s dialogue at [spoiler]the chess group in the Park[/spoiler] would sometimes get stuck, blocking the rest of the day from progressing. This should fix similar bugs in other locations like [spoiler] Moira at the lighthouse or the concert being stuck at ""Wohooo""[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed a bug where Walt [spoiler] was not finishing the Writing Quest.[/spoiler]
[*] Fixed a softlock where you could not confirm the pop-up on the gamepad after [spoiler]adopting the dog[/spoiler].
[*] Fixed the start of a late-game questline.
[*] Fixed a Harper [spoiler]cave spelunking[/spoiler] UX issue.
[*] Further adjusted book tags.
[*] Made drama and play requests more distinct in CN and HANT.
[*] Fixed Seagull audio not being controlled by the volume sliders.
[/list]

As always, you can report issues by pressing F2, and make sure you leave a contact, just in case we have questions or tips for you!

We are thankful for having such a wonderful community! ♥️✨

notes.title: Demo Refresh for Steam Next Fest!!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello there, Bookseller! With Steam Next Fest just around the corner, we’re back with some exciting updates![/h2][p][/p][p]Well, firstly is of course, we'll be in the next Steam Next Fest, from [b]June 9 - June 16th![/b] 👀 And secondly, as Tiny Bookshop gets closer to launch, our demo could really use a refresh! Check out what we have been working on:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918095/0c7037c3a6340223005112b42a4817da2bc435e7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]✨Demo Refresh for Steam Next Fest![/h2][p]Believe it or not, the original Tiny Bookshop demo is almost a year old now! [/p][p]Since then, we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, listening to your feedback, making improvements, and polishing up the experience. And as new indie devs on the scene, we have learned so much from this experience! So for the upcoming Steam Next Fest, [b]we are relaunching the Tiny Bookshop demo TODAY[/b], on the 7th of June! Players can experience the first 3 days of Tiny Bookshop with some improved features and quality of life additions.[/p][p][/p][h3]Now I know what you must be wondering.. [b]What's New in the Demo?[/b][/h3][p]We've written up a whole changelog with all the new things that you can expect![/p][h3][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2133760/view/542233572484843534"]→ Check Out What's New Here![/url][/h3][p][/p][h2]🐛 What To Do if You Find a Bug![/h2][p]We done our best to ensure smooth gameplay for this demo refresh, but if there is anything that fell through the cracks, check out what you can do on our Bug Report Post to give us a heads-up![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2133760/view/4165346503348817164"]Tiny Bookshop - So you've found a bug while playing the Tiny Bookshop Demo? - Steam News[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]🌍 Quick Note on Demo Length & Languages.[/h2][p]We know many of you were hoping for an extended demo. notes.title: Demo Refresh CHANGELOG
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Booksellers! Our tiny team been quietly tinkering behind the scenes, dusting shelves, sorting books, and listening closely to your feedback. With the refreshed Tiny Bookshop demo, this is what you can expect:[/h2]

[h2][b]⭐ What's New in the Demo Refresh? ⭐[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]1. [/b]📚 [b]Book Recommendations[/b][/h3]
[p]First up, let’s talk about one of Tiny Bookshop’s most unique feature. We’ve received so much feedback from the demo, and we’ve been hard at work making improvements. In this new demo refresh, we’ve revamped and made a bunch of adjustments to improve the recommendation system.[/p][list][*][p][b]Clearer Book Requests[/b] – We've massively reworked and reworded NPC requests. They are now easier to understand, more sensible, and their responses are slightly less harsh.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Favourite Book Hint[/b] – If someone mentions their favourite book, you can now view its description right within the request, saving you a Google Search side quest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]No More "Meh"[/b] – Customers no longer respond with apathy when given semi-fitting book suggestions (rude). Instead, they’ll be pleasantly surprised when you recommend an unexpected book. Everyone should be willing to try something a little bit different![/p][/*][*][p][b]Always An Answer![/b] – We’ve also tweaked how customer requests are generated. Now, customers will ask for something that matches a book already in your current inventory. That means fewer “sorry, I don’t have anything” moments and more satisfying decisions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Polite Bookseller[/b] –  Don't lie to your customer! By popular demand, "Sorry, we're closed" is now changed to something more fitting![/p][/*][*][p][b]Difficulty Indicator[/b] – There's now a difficulty indicator for recommendation requests, making difficult requests a little more obvious and hopefully rewarding.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dual Genre Tutorial[/b] – We've added a tutorial explaining how books can belong to multiple genres. Think [i]Dracula[/i], is it a classic or fantasy? It’s both![/p][/*][*][p][b]Less Duplicated Books[/b] – You are now much less likely to find the same book twice, when going through your shelf.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Recommendation Sale Boost[/b] – After you nailed a recommendation, customers become [i]Inspired[/i], briefly boosting everyone’s chance to make a purchase. May your kindness spark bookish joy![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]2. 🫶 Accessibility[/b][/h3][p]Secondly, we know coziness feels different for different people, so we’ve introduced a host of [b]new accessibility settings[/b] to make Tiny Bookshop more accessible to players with different gaming needs![/p][p]
[u]General:[/u][/p][list][*][p][b]Recommendation Timing[/b] – You can now adjust how long customers will wait for book recommendations, giving you more breathing room to play at your own pace![/p][/*][*][p][b]Auto-Accept Recommendations[/b] – Don’t want to click recommendation bubbles at all? No problem. Let the game auto-accept them for you![/p][/*][/list][p][u]Mouse and Keyboard:[/u][/p][list][*][p][b]Pause on Tooltip[/b] – We've added a setting to automatically pause the game when reading a tooltip. This is especially useful when inspecting timed effects and detailed info.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We removed the need to click and hold or click and drag completely on mouse and keyboard.[/p][list][*][p][b]Click and Place Decorating[/b] – In customisation, instead of clicking and dragging. You can now simply click to pick up and click to place when decorating your wagon.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Camera Control Setting[/b] – [b]"Cursor at Screen Edge"[/b], which can be used instead of the default [b]"Click and Drag"[/b]. This moves the camera as you hover near the screen borders.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][u]Controller:[/u][/p][list][*][p][b]Hold-to-Confirm Settings[/b] – Sometimes throughout the game, we ask you to hold a button to confirm an important choice. Because this can be a problem for some players, you can now toggle a setting that removes that requirement entirely.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customizable Movement [/b]– To move the view, it is still necessary to move and hold one of the sticks in the desired direction. So stick sensitivity and movement speed can now be finely tuned in the settings to feels just right.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Optional Haptics[/b] – While our haptics are subtle, you can now turn them off completely if you prefer to play without haptics, or may find haptics uncomfortable.[/p][/*][/list][p][u]Ease of Use Enhancements:[/u][/p][list][*][p][b]Smarter Graphics Defaults [/b]– The game will now do its best to approximate a combination of settings that works well on your device on first launch.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Settings Tooltips[/b] – All settings now contain detailed tooltips to help you understand exactly what it does.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]3. 📒 Journal Updates[/b][/h3][p]Your journal has received some much needed glow-up:[/p][list][*][p][b]Chapter Navigation[/b] – Flipping through your notes is easier than ever.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Calendar Page[/b] – There's now a brand new calendar page in the Journal, showing you upcoming events, and helping you keep track of all the things that happened this seasons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bookshop Stat Page[/b] – The new [b]Stats page[/b] gives a detailed overview of your shop’s current setup and how it’s affecting your business. Great for aspiring expert booksellers who want to fine-tune their strategy.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character Pages[/b] – There are now pages dedicated to Special Friends you'll make, with space to document memories and quests.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]4. [/b]👗[b] Visual Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Customer Variety[/b] – There's now more variety in people's outfits. They can show up wearing hats, bags, umbrellas or raincoats, and so much more![/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Visual Effects[/b] – We've reworked the visual look of the game, and improved the look of shadows and visual effects throughout Tiny Bookshop.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]5. [/b]🎶 [b]Sound Design[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Morning and Evening Music[/b] – We’ve added peaceful morning and evening music to frame your day in a gentle ambience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Recommendation Music[/b] – The recommendation scene now has chill music to help you get into a thinking space![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Sound Effects[/b] – We've added new sound effects to book recommendations and journal navigation.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]6. 🎨 Customisation[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Item Filters[/b] – We added filters to easier find that one item you want to decorate your bookshop with and make it easier to try out different builds.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]7. 🗞️ Newspaper[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Sales Report[/b] – From time to time you will get a sales report in your newspaper to see how you are doing.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We hope these changes will help give players a better gaming experience and give you a good taste of what's to come in the full release![/p]

[h2]🐛 What To Do if You Find a Bug! 🐛[/h2]
[p]We done our best to ensure smooth gameplay for this demo refresh, but if there is anything that fell through the cracks, check out what you can do on our Bug Report Post to give us a heads-up![/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2133760/view/4165346503348817164"]Tiny Bookshop - So you've found a bug while playing the Tiny Bookshop Demo? - Steam News[/url][/p][p][/p][p]As always, thank you so much to everyone for your continuous support! And have fun book selling![/p][p]Until next time![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2133760/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Demo Version 1.12
notes.content:
[h1]Demo version 1.12[/h1]
[h2]Bugs:[/h2]
🔧 Fixed a bug causing corrupted save files in the newspaper, potentially causing some stuck loading screens
🔧 Fixed a bug when loading another scene, potentially causing some stuck loading screens
🔧 Fixed a minor-bug when loading scenes while animations are playing, potentially causing some stuck loading screens
🔧 Adjusted the box size of a tutorial hint so it remains readable in ES, DE, and FR
🔧 Added an auto-equip if users unequipped the shelf and quit in the customization screen
- Fixes stuck in stocking screen tutorial bug
- Fixes stuck in recommendation screen tutorial bug
🔧Fixed bug panel not showing up while between scenes
🔧 Fixed bug that allowed the boost arrows to stay visible after an effect stopped
🔧 Fixed typo in FR Tilde dialogue
🔧 Fixed typo in FR Gazette title
🔧 Fixed inflating birds when clicking too rapidly on them
🔧 Added an actual request behind Tilde's kinda rude context-less one
[h2]Polish:[/h2]
✨ Removed hyphenation from the dialogue text box
✨ Added 20 unique books for ES
✨ Added thank you for playing message on day 4, to better communicate the end of the demo on the map
✨ Adjusted spacing in the newspaper for bold texts
✨ Enabled resizing when playing the game in windowed mode
✨ Added version display to the escape-menu
✨ Bug reports now automatically include log messages, improving the bug fixing workflow
[h2]Notes:[/h2]
❗ Some crashes on devices without a dedicated GPU or an older GPU [b]might be due to the demo being slightly too demanding on the hardware[/b]. We'll be optimizing the final version of the game of course, but for now, consider [b]lowering the resolution in full-screen mode, lowering the Anti-Aliasing Settings, turning off Ambient Occlusion, and turning off VSync[/b] can all help improve performance and stability.
❗ [b]Loading screen bugs can have a variety of causes with the same symptom[/b], so yours might be gone, or still present after these fixes. Thank you so much to everyone who reached out and tried to help. Please still do, [b]if you continue to encounter this bug, F2 + contact info is the best way to figure this out.[/b]
❗[b] Because this patch contains fixes that address save-file corruption, it will reset your saved game.[/b]

[b]Thank you everyone for the kind words, we were absolutely blown away! We are incredibly thankful for having such a thoughtful and passionate community![/b]

And thank you everyone for your thorough and diligent reports!

notes.title: PUBLIC DEMO AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Dear loyal and devoted bookworms,

What you heard at Wholesome Direct is true! The time has come! Your pleas have been answered! 
[h3][b]TINY BOOKSHOP NOW HAS A PUBLIC DEMO![/b][/h3]
🎉 🎉 🎉
We are so excited to finally share some of the new gameplay with you all! If you'd like some more info on what that demo entails, here is all you need to know:
[list]
[*] [b]How do I play the demo?[/b] — Download it right here [u]on Steam[/u]! 
[*] [b]When can I play it?[/b] — [u]Right now[/u]! Until the end of June.
[*] [b]What languages will it be available in?[/b] — [u]English[/u] and [u]German[/u].
French and Spanish are added as well, but they have not been thoroughly tested, so please feel free to give us your feedback!
[*] [b]Is there gamepad support?[/b] — [u]Yes[/u]! And we are quite proud of it!
[*] [b]How long is it?[/b] — You can play for 3 days in-game, which equals to [u]about 30 minutes[/u] in real time. And after the credits, you can still continue decorating your bookshop! 
[*] [b]What can I do in it?[/b] — Firstly, you will be introduced to the game mechanics with our brand new tutorial. As always, you can explore locations, talk to our characters, browse the newspaper, customise your bookshop, and of course sell books. 
For the first time, you can also learn more about locations in your journal, master challenges and quests, and [u]recommend specific book titles[/u] to your customers!
[*] [b]Where can I go if I have questions?[/b] — We have set up a brand new [u]community Discord server[/u] for our marvellous fans [url=https://discord.gg/uj6uhS3P6M]right here[/url]! Join your fellow book worms in discussing the game and share your feedback with us, the developers!
[*] [b]How can I help improve the game?[/b] — Since the game is still in development, this demo may contain some bugs, typos, mistranslations, or inconsistencies. If you notice any, it would be helpful if you could report them via our custom bug reporting tool, by [u]pressing F2[/u]! We will provide a more detailed guide to bug reporting in a follow-up post today. 
We'd also love to hear your ideas, suggestions, concerns, or praise ;) over on the Tiny Bookshop Discord.
[/list]
We are so excited to hear your thoughts on the game, and thank you all for your incredible patience! We hope you have fun with our little demo, and would love to see you all soon over on Discord. <3

Lots of love,
Your neoludic Team

notes.title: So you've found a bug while playing the Tiny Bookshop Demo?
notes.content:
[h2]Hi there! Seems like you've run into a problem with our demo! Here's how you can report it to us and help us improve the game for the future.[/h2]

🪲 [b]The best way to report a bug is when encountering it. Pressing F2 in-game to bring up our in-game bug-reporting tool. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918095/ed6c5d9ba8de693c17c916130f87ef9e62783786.gif[/img]
This allows us to learn where the bug occurred, along with automatically taking a screenshot, and collecting info on which type of device this happened on. You’ll still have to give our six-legged friend a good name and a detailed description of how you got there, to better help our team find it. 
In case we have follow-up questions, it would be fantastic if you could share a way to contact you, but no pressure!  
Lastly, you can tell us how urgent this bug is, so we can get to the really bad stuff first. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918095/19e0d4aa5a9fd5fb87da624f7b6512bb7e632400.png[/img]

🪲 If this is somehow not an option for you, or you’d like some help from us because you can't continue the demo, or you’d like the community’s help in figuring something out, then you are welcome to share it on our brand new [b]community Discord server[/b] ([url=https://discord.gg/uj6uhS3P6M]join here[/url]). In this case, please include a screenshot/video/gif of what happened, a detailed description, some information on your current device, whether you played with mouse or with gamepad, and how we can replicate it.

Thank you for taking the time to help us out! It's the best way to ensure an amazing finished product. We wish you lots of fun with continuing the demo! 🧡

Cheers,
Your neoludic Team

notes.title: Wholesome Direct Update
notes.content:
Dear bookworms,
We are excited to finally show you all the changes and improvements we have made to Tiny Bookshop since last year ✨

Starting with a fresh new Trailer, just for the occasion: 
[previewyoutube=vrZs644YqSQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The first big change is the updated art-style:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918095/a8989519e6ccee5472afaf38f932e12ddef3086f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918095/b6dacec2c6720d3db42b0a37afd54eb881a28d08.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918095/afbd2274421f7baddb6ea39981c6dad62d876cae.jpg[/img]

Now Tiny Bookshop features vibrant pastels, luscious greenery and a fully dynamic sky. This rework also allowed us to add something many of you requested:
You can now pan around, explore locations, find little hidden treasures and listen in on background conversations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918095/5657e0d99114351df2288a02f7c36cead90d882c.gif[/img]

We have also reworked customization, to allow you to place items anywhere, even inside the Bookshop! 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918095/447a0ce199ac3538dac4605ae876c53f9e5e00b0.jpg[/img]

And painting has been reworked to allow you to paint everything, in any combination you like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918095/302dd4da124f0838b97a38e2133bd0cbafb9f847.gif[/img]

While it will still be a little while until Tiny Bookshop will be ready for release, we have created a little demo, which you will be able to play at [b]Gamescom[/b] this year! And we are working hard to make it available online shortly after that as well, so make sure to [b]follow[/b] to receive a notification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918095/a03e1406946e0943b05b18e44f60a4037e41729f.jpg[/img]

Thank you for being with us on this journey! Your support and lovely comments really mean the world to us! 
Tiny Bookshop will still take a little while to release, thank you so much for your patience and support. You all really keep us going!!!

notes.title: Tiny Bookshop FAQ
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Steam Community! We're trying out this new feature, so here's a little [b]FAQ![/b][/h1]

[h3]We decided to share some answers to the three most common questions we’ve received about Tiny Bookshop:[/h3]

[olist]
[*] What platforms will Tiny Bookshop be on?
We are working to release Tiny Bookshop [u]right here on Steam[/u] for Windows, Linux, Mac, and Steamdeck, as well as on the App Store for Mac. 
We can’t promise any other platforms yet 💔 But we hear all of your calls for other platforms, and are working out ways we can make those possible eventually!

[*] Will I need a Gaming PC to play the game?
[u]Not at all![/u] Newer Apple devices (with M1 Chip and above) will be great, and lower end PCs and Windows laptops should also be able to run Tiny Bookshop easily.

[*] Will the game be free?
No, sorry, that wouldn’t really work for us. 
But, in exchange for paying for the game, you get to support a small indie team, and are spared the bad monetization practices. 🙈
[/olist]

[h2]Want to know anything else about the game? Take part in the discussion below to find out more![/h2]
